original_article.research:
[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Darweish Mohamed was found critically wounded outside Craigieburn community hospital on Wednesday evening

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

A third teenager has been charged over the fatal stabbing of a 15-year-old boy found outside a Melbourne hospital.

A 14-year-old from Victoria’s Hume area was arrested on Friday evening and was charged with murder, police said.He has been scheduled to appear before a children’s court.

Mickleham teenager Darweish Mohamed was found critically wounded outside Craigieburn community hospital, in the city’s north, about 7.50pm on Wednesday.

A staff member from the clinic rushed to his aid and delivered CPR but he died at the scene.

Police arrested two people in the nearby suburb of Pascoe Vale early on Thursday.

A 16-year-old boy from the Goulburn Valley was charged with murder and remanded in custody to appear in a children’s court. A 20-year-old man from Beveridge was also charged with criminal damage by fire and bailed to appear at Broadmeadows magistrates court on 1 December.

A burnt-out car found at Oaklands Junction has also been linked to the stabbing.

Later on Friday, police said a second murder charge had been laid against a 15-year-old boy from the Craigieburn area. He will also face a children’s court.

A 15-year-old girl from the Fawkner area has been charged with affray and theft of motor vehicle and bailed to appear in a children’s court at a later date.

Loved ones of Darweish have asked community members to keep him in their prayers.

Family friend Mohamed Bakhit launched a GoFundMe campaign to raise funds to meet his funeral expenses.

“It is with heavy hearts that we share the passing of our beloved brother, Darweish,” the fundraiser page reads.

“No family should ever have to go through a loss like this and our hearts are with his loved ones during this incredibly difficult time.”

The campaign had raised more than $54,000 towards a goal of $60,000 by Saturday morning. It asks those who are unable to donate to keep Darweish and his family in their du’as, an Arabic word for a form of Islamic prayer.

Asked about the Mount Ridley College student’s death, Victoria’s education department confirmed it would provide support to affected school communities.

“The death of any young person is a tragedy,” a spokesperson told AAP.

“The death of the young person in a violent incident on Wednesday will be extremely distressing for the local communities involved.”

---

[Lähde: 7NEWS Australia]
A third teenager has been charged with the alleged stabbing death of a 15-year-old boy.

Darweish Mohamed, 15, was found bleeding in the carpark of the medical centre Craigieburn Community Hospital on Lygon Dr in Craigieburn about 7.50pm on Wednesday.

An employee at the hospital performed CPR, but he died at the scene.

Know the news with the 7NEWS app: Download today

A burnt out car was later found by police who believe it is linked to the alleged murder.

A 16-year-old Goulburn Valley boy was arrested on Thursday morning alongside a 20-year-old Beveridge man in Pascoe Vale.

The 16-year-old boy has been charged with murder. He will face court at a later date, police said on Friday.

The 20-year-old man was charged with criminal damage by fire. He was bailed and will also face Melbourne Magistrate’s Court on December 1.

Police later arrested a 15-year-old from Craigieburn and a 14-year-old from Hume. Both have since been charged with murder and will appear in a children’s court at a later date.

A 15-year-old girl from Fawkner was also arrested and charged with affray and stealing a car. She was granted bail ahead of an appearance at a children’s court.

Investigations into the alleged murder remain ongoing and anyone with information has been urged to come forward.

Heartfelt tributes to Darweish have been posted on social media, along with a video montage of Darweish dancing and smiling with friends.

The acronyms “LLD” — which stand for “long live Darweish” — and “E4D” — standing for “everything for Darweish”, flooded comments section.

A fundraiser has been created to help Darweish’s family with funeral costs, and “ease some of the burden on his family”.

“It is with heavy hearts that we share the passing of our beloved brother, Darweish,” said organiser Mohamed Bakhit.

“No family should ever have to go through a loss like this, and our hearts are with his loved ones during this incredibly difficult time.”

payload.title: Kolmas teini-ikäinen sai murhasyytteen 15-vuotiaan pojan kuolemasta Melbournessa
payload.summary: Australian poliisi on nostanut kolmannen murhasyytteen tapauksessa, jossa 15-vuotias Darweish Mohamed kuoli löydyttyään vakavasti haavoittuneena Craigieburn Community Hospitalin ulkopuolelta Melbournen pohjoisosassa.
payload.content:
15-vuotias Darweish Mohamed löydettiin vakavasti haavoittuneena Craigieburn Community Hospitalin ulkopuolelta Melbournen pohjoisosassa keskiviikkoiltana noin kello 19.50. Poliisin mukaan tapauksessa on nyt syytetty murhasta kolmatta teini-ikäistä, 14-vuotiasta Humen alueelta kotoisin olevaa poikaa, joka pidätettiin perjantai-iltana.

## Poika kuoli sairaalan pihalla

Micklehamista kotoisin ollut Mohamed löydettiin verta vuotavana sairaalan pysäköintialueelta Lygon Drivella Craigieburnissa. Sairaalan työntekijä kiirehti hänen avukseen ja antoi elvytystä, mutta poika kuoli tapahtumapaikalla. Poliisi on kuvannut tapausta epäiltynä puukotuskuolemana.

Tutkintaan on liitetty myös palanut auto, jonka poliisi löysi myöhemmin Oaklands Junctionista. Poliisin mukaan auton uskotaan liittyvän epäiltyyn henkirikokseen.

## Useita pidätyksiä ja syytteitä

Kolmannen murhasyytteen lisäksi poliisi on kertonut kahdesta aiemmasta murhasyytteestä. Goulburn Valleysta kotoisin oleva 16-vuotias poika pidätettiin torstaiaamuna Pascoe Valessa yhdessä 20-vuotiaan Beveridgestä kotoisin olevan miehen kanssa. 16-vuotiasta syytetään murhasta, ja hänet määrättiin tutkintavankeuteen odottamaan käsittelyä lasten tuomioistuimessa.

Perjantaina poliisi kertoi myös toisesta murhasyytteestä, joka nostettiin Craigieburnin alueelta olevaa 15-vuotiasta poikaa vastaan. Hänenkin asiansa on määrä käsitellä lasten tuomioistuimessa. Myös Humen alueelta pidätetyn 14-vuotiaan pojan on määrä saapua lasten tuomioistuimeen.

## Muut epäillyt ja seuraavat käsittelyt

Beveridgestä kotoisin olevaa 20-vuotiasta miestä syytetään paloon liittyvästä vahingonteosta. Hänet vapautettiin takuita vastaan, ja hänen on määrä saapua Broadmeadowsin tuomioistuimeen 1. joulukuuta.

Poliisi on kertonut myös 15-vuotiaasta Fawknerin alueelta kotoisin olevasta tytöstä, jota syytetään joukkotappelusta ja moottoriajoneuvon varkaudesta. Hänet vapautettiin takuita vastaan odottamaan myöhempää käsittelyä lasten tuomioistuimessa. Mohamedin läheiset ovat pyytäneet yhteisön jäseniä pitämään hänet rukouksissaan.
